name: Mummy
description: Adds the Mummy, a cute bandage-wrapped desert undead with flowing bandages, and rare zombie royalty: the Zombie King with a billowing red cape and the Zombie Princess in a swishing pink dress, who stick together and celebrate with fireworks; their knights (on zombie horses) and archers; abandoned zombie kingdoms with a castle and a stable; and Verity, the sunshine-yellow smiley zombie.
